messages:
toni (Design): quick design check 15: region selector in Compliance -> Encryption. trying to show which regions use Redwood-managed keys vs. customer-provided KMS. mock attached. want copy + a11y + keyboard feedback.

mohit (Product): two product asks: auto-select account default but allow override. expand BYOK to 'bring your own key' inline.

kevin (Eng): tech constraints: custom combobox for modern browsers, fallback native select otherwise. must implement aria-activedescendant + aria-describedby. add aria-live for announcements. sample pattern posted.

samir (Security): label clarity: avoid "Encrypted" alone. use "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". change any "key id" mentions to "key reference". helper copy should note audit logs will include region + key reference when BYOK is used.

allegra (PM): if tenant hasn't configured BYOK, show BYOK option disabled with tooltip: "Requires uploaded key and IAM role; see docs." keep option visible but disabled.

toni (Design): updated microcopy idea: list labels short: "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". helper text under control: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." link helper via aria-describedby.

mohit (Product): visual: use distinct badges + icons (shield vs key), but not color-only. ensure contrast >= 4.5:1.

kevin (Eng): accessibility: helper text should be linked with aria-describedby (not inside listbox). aria-live status should say: "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key reference."

a11y-bot: checklist: combobox pattern, aria-activedescendant updates, aria-describedby present, focus outline visible, badge contrast >= 4.5:1. manual review required.

samir (Security): audit log example suggestion: "action: inference.request, region: eu-west-1, key_reference: projects/abc/keys/key-123 (customer-managed)". Also include modal language noting key material never leaves customer control.

toni (Design): modal flow: title "Switch to customer-managed KMS (BYOK)", body "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. You must upload or grant access to the key to complete." add propagation note: "Changes may take up to 2 minutes to propagate." buttons: Cancel / Continue. initial focus on primary action, Esc closes, focus trap.

allegra (PM): add tiny "learn more" link in helper text that opens docs in new tab and emits analytics event.

kevin (Eng): tests: assert aria-describedby present, aria-live updates include region + key usage, fallback to native select works. Samir to provide audit regression prompts.

samir (Security): will add CI tests: enable BYOK, change region, verify audit entry includes region + key_reference; verify disabled BYOK doesn't leak key_reference.

toni (Design): punchlist I'll push: revised badges (shield/key), helper copy tied to aria-describedby, modal copy + propagation note, disabled BYOK tooltip copy, and a short a11y checklist to the ticket. will post updated mock later today.
